extracted.name: Barb's Broccoli-Cauliflower Salad
extracted.description: This broccoli-cauliflower salad has a delicious flavor thanks to the addition of bacon bits, sunflower seeds, red onion, and a creamy dressing.
instruction_lines: Place bacon in a large skillet and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain bacon slices on paper towels; crumble.
Combine bacon, cauliflower, broccoli, sunflower seeds, and onion in a large bowl.
Whisk salad dressing, sugar, and vinegar together in a jug until blended. Pour over cauliflower mixture and toss to coat.
Refrigerate salad and allow to chill before serving.
